retired: ffi-bridge library tests whose only claim was an id, a receipt or file existence, a literal count or a self-comparison
classification: Each test of `cargo test --lib` in a module with a failing test was read with the code it exercises and classified by content. A test that computes (a gate decision, a constant from the generated table, a value a Lean theorem proves) is kept and repaired against the current sources; a test whose only claim is a fleet, wave or receipt id, the existence of a file or receipt, a literal count, a constant-false status flag or a comparison of a constant with its own definition is retired, with the code that existed only to feed it. Before: 84 lib tests, 32 failing. After: 42 lib tests, all passing.

repaired.change: Q_hyd was looked up as q_hyd_j_per_kg in the umst-math registry at the pinned umst-manifold rev, which has no such row. It is now read from umst-constants (row hydrationHeatDefault, the value Lean Concrete.Gate.Q_hyd is defined as), in its table unit J/g; the test checks the row, its exact rational and the Lean binding.
